name: EES Hedger
summary: EES Hedger is a hedging Expert Advisor that opens opposing positions to protect existing trades from adverse market moves. It dynamically manages hedge positions based on market conditions and account exposure, aiming to limit drawdown while preserving profit potential. The EA systematically creates offsetting orders when certain loss thresholds or market divergence criteria are met.
summary_zh: EES Hedger是一个对冲专家顾问，通过开设反向仓位来保护现有交易免受不利市场变动的影响。它根据市场条件和账户敞口动态管理对冲仓位，旨在限制回撤同时保留盈利潜力。当达到特定亏损阈值或市场分歧标准时，该EA系统性地创建对冲订单。
strategy_analysis: EES Hedger的核心策略是对冲保护，当已有持仓浮亏达到设定阈值时自动开设反向仓位以锁定风险。入场条件基于账户浮亏比例或绝对金额触发，也可结合价格偏离指标判断是否需要对冲。出场条件包括对冲仓位在主仓位平仓时同步平仓，或当对冲仓位本身盈利达到目标时独立平仓。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的大小通常与主仓位成比例，可根据用户设定的对冲比例调整。资金管理上，EA会监控账户整体风险敞口，在总风险超限时增加对冲力度。整体策略偏向防御性，适合波动较大的市场环境但可能增加交易成本。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of EES Hedger is protective hedging, automatically opening opposing positions when floating losses on existing trades reach a configured threshold. Entry conditions are triggered by account drawdown percentage or absolute loss amount, and may also incorporate price deviation indicators to determine when hedging is necessary. Exit conditions include closing hedge positions simultaneously with the main position, or independently closing hedges when they reach their own profit targets. Position sizing for hedge orders is typically proportional to the main position, adjustable via a user-configured hedge ratio parameter. Money management involves monitoring overall account risk exposure and increasing hedge intensity when total risk exceeds acceptable limits. The overall strategy is defensive in nature, suitable for volatile market environments but potentially increasing trading costs due to spread and swap charges.

parameters.name: HedgeTriggerPercent
parameters.description: 触发对冲的浮亏百分比阈值
parameters.description_en: Floating loss percentage to trigger hedge

parameters.name: HedgeLotRatio
parameters.description: 对冲仓位与主仓位的比例
parameters.description_en: Hedge position to main position lot ratio

parameters.name: MaxHedgePositions
parameters.description: 最大允许的对冲持仓数量

parameters.name: CloseHedgeOnProfit
parameters.description: 对冲仓位盈利时是否自动平仓

parameters.name: StopLossHedge
parameters.description: 对冲仓位的止损点数，0为不设止损

pros: 对冲策略能有效限制单边风险敞口，降低账户最大回撤
参数化设计灵活，用户可调整触发阈值和对冲比例适应不同市场
在剧烈波动或黑天鹅事件中提供额外的账户保护层
系统化执行避免情绪化决策，确保对冲纪律性
pros_en: Hedging strategy effectively limits directional risk exposure and reduces maximum account drawdown
Flexible parameterized design allows users to adjust trigger thresholds and hedge ratios for different markets
Provides an additional layer of account protection during extreme volatility or black swan events
Systematic execution avoids emotional decision-making and ensures hedging discipline
cons: 对冲增加交易成本，包括点差和隔夜利息费用，长期可能侵蚀利润
在震荡市中可能频繁触发对冲导致过度交易和成本累积
未设置止损的对冲仓位本身可能成为新的风险源
对冲可能锁定浮亏而非真正解决方向性判断错误的问题
cons_en: Hedging increases trading costs including spread and overnight swap fees, which can erode profits over time
May trigger hedges too frequently in choppy markets, leading to over-trading and cost accumulation
Hedge positions without stop losses can themselves become new sources of risk
Hedging may lock in floating losses rather than truly addressing the underlying directional judgment error
improvements: 增加市场波动率过滤器（如ATR），避免在低波动环境下不必要的对冲触发
实现智能对冲平仓逻辑，当主仓位方向判断正确时逐步减少对冲而非一次性平仓
加入隔夜利息成本计算，在对冲成本超过潜在保护收益时抑制对冲操作
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to avoid unnecessary hedge triggers in low-volatility environments
Implement intelligent hedge reduction logic, gradually decreasing hedge exposure when the main position direction proves correct rather than closing all at once
Incorporate swap cost calculation to suppress hedging when carry costs exceed the potential protective benefit

risk_points: 对冲仓位若未设止损可能在极端行情中扩大亏损
频繁对冲触发会导致点差成本累积
未检测新K线可能导致同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Hedge positions without stop losses may amplify losses in extreme market conditions
Frequent hedge triggers can lead to accumulated spread costs
Lack of new bar detection may cause duplicate position opens within the same candle
